note: Bank lines T1, T4-T8 of review/last-fixes-decisions.json (Al, 30 Sept 2026): air temperatures dropped from the condition bank in five languages. zu/xh/st written with the zu-qc, xh-qc and st-qc guidance (SA Sesotho orthography) and run through scripts/lang-check/triage.mjs: nothing rated triage-high; two lower-confidence semantic notes on xh T7 ('Indlela', unchanged from the old line) and st T6/T7 ('malapa', 'matla'), for a native to read. rows.en: 7pm and still this hot. The Karoo doesn't make mistakes, only statements.
rows.af: 19:00 en steeds so warm. Die Karoo maak nie foute nie, net stellings.
rows.zu: Ngu-7 ntambama futhi kusashisa kangaka. IKaroo ayenzi amaphutha, izitatimende kuphela.
rows.xh: Ngo-7 ngokuhlwa kusashushu kangaka. IKaroo ayenzi zimpazamo, izenza izibhengezo kuphela.
rows.st: 7pm 'me e ntse e tjhesa jwalo. Karoo ha e etse diphoso, ke ditlhaloso feela.

rows.en: First star is out. The warmth has clocked out too.
rows.af: Eerste ster is uit. Die warmte het ook uitgeklok.
rows.zu: Inkanyezi yokuqala isiphumile. Ukufudumala nakho sekuphumile emsebenzini.
rows.xh: Inkwenkwezi yokuqala iphumile. Ubushushu nabo sele buphumile emsebenzini.
rows.st: Naledi ya pele e tjhabile. Mofuthu le wona o tswile mosebetsing.

rows.en: The sun is heading home now, taking the last of the warmth with it.
rows.af: Die son gaan nou huis toe. Vat die laaste bietjie warmte saam.
rows.zu: Ilanga liya ekhaya manje, lithathe ukufudumala kokugcina kanye nalo.
rows.xh: Ilanga liya ekhaya ngoku, lithatha ubushushu obokugqibela nalo.
rows.st: Letsatsi le ya hae jwale, le nka mofuthu wa ho qetela le lona.

rows.en: Outside: freezing. Inside: barely better, and a very good fire. SA homes, hey.
rows.af: Buite: yskoud. Binne: skaars beter, en 'n baie goeie vuur. SA huise, nè.
rows.zu: Ngaphandle: kubanda kakhulu. Ngaphakathi: kungcono kancane nje, nomlilo omuhle kakhulu. Amakhaya aseSA, hey.
rows.xh: Ngaphandle: kubanda kakhulu. Ngaphakathi: kungcono kancinci nje, nomlilo omhle kakhulu. Amakhaya aseMzantsi, andithi.
rows.st: Kantle: ho a bata haholo. Ka hare: ho molemo hanyane feela, le mollo o hotle haholo. Malapa a SA, hey.

rows.en: The pass is beautiful. The pass is also the opening act for a hard frost.
rows.af: Die pas is mooi. Die pas is ook 'n harde ryp se voorprogram.
rows.zu: I-pass inhle. I-pass iphinde ibe umdlalo wokuvula wesithwathwa esinzima.
rows.xh: Indlela yasezintabeni intle. Ikwavula umboniso weqabaka elinzima.
rows.st: Pass e ntle. Pass hape ke selelekela sa serame se matla.

rows.en: The first sip after a day this hot should honestly be taxable.
rows.af: Die eerste sluk ná só 'n warm dag behoort eerlikwaar belasbaar te wees.
rows.zu: Ukuphuza kokuqala ngemva kosuku olushisa kangaka kufanele eqinisweni kukhokhelwe intela.
